QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Kerning Square's Superstar
QuestInfo.0: You see #b#p1052205##k, #p1052203#'s groupie. Ask her about #p1052203#.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052205# was unhappy because she couldn't get a pass to #p1052203#'s signing event. The pass is inside #t4036027:#. Gather #b25#k #b#i4036027:# #t4036027:##k items from #r#o4310000##k and #r#o4310001##k in #r#m103041165##k, then take them to #b#p1052205##k.
QuestInfo.2: There was a pass for the signing event among the #b25#k #b#i4036027:# #t4036027:##k items you brought back. #p1052205# told you the juicy information she promised, which turned out to be #p1052203#'s shoe size. #p1052203# was such a superstar back in the day that apparently even his shoe size was sexy.

0.msg: So, you're here to see #p1052203#, eh? I guess he's pretty cool.

1.msg: Oh, so you're a fan of #p1052203#, too? Then you're probably not willing to give me your pass to #p1052203#'s signing event...

3.msg: I can't call myself #p1052203#'s fan if I don't get into that signing event. I NEED that pass. If you help me out, I'll tell you a juicy secret about him...

yes.0: Wow! For one of #p1052203#'s fans, you're really nice! He's the number one singer with a number one fan club!
yes.1: If you could bring me around #b25#k #b#i4036027:# #t4036027:##k items, I'm sure at least one of them has to have a pass inside. #r#o4310000##k and #r#o4310001##k monsters in #r#m103041165##k will have them!

no.0: Of all the people... I can't miss the signing event! This is so unfair...

1.0: There must be a pass for the signing event here. Oh, please be here...

yes.0: ...THIS IS IT! I can go to the signing now! Thank you SO SO SO much!
yes.1: Oh, that's right! I promised to tell you some juicy gossip about \r\n#p1052203#. Well, not many know this, so keep it under wraps...
yes.3: ...#p1052203# wears size 9 shoes! Isn't that cool?
